finding: Motion+Search v2.1 collapses exactly after fusion activation
interpretation: The failure aligns with the 10-19 ramp and is not a late-training overfit pattern.

evidence: epoch60 center loss search/full=0.02220/0.02127; observation error=0.248/0.248 m
interpretation: The recursive validation collapse is downstream of auxiliary proposal use, not visible as B0 supervised-loss degradation.

finding: The advantage gate is not selective
evidence: search-only selects about 97.8% of valid Search rows; helpful precision 55.8% versus 54.7% prevalence; conditional weight about 0.486
interpretation: The gate behaves close to an availability gate and nearly reaches the normal 0.5 mass cap, failing the 70% helpful-precision target.

finding: Motion is over-used relative to its helpfulness
evidence: epoch60 valid=90.4%, helpful=16.9%, conditional applied weight about 0.272; motion/search/obs error=0.270/0.243/0.248 m
interpretation: Teacher-forced one-step fused loss rewards partial corrections that are not safe under recursive history feedback.

finding: Invalid Search rows inject a 1e6 ESS feature into the shared gate
evidence: epoch60 Search unavailable=69.3%; logged mean ESS=692950, while inferred valid-row ESS is about 8.4 and the branch contains at most 128 points
interpretation: _masked_softmax returns zero weights for invalid rows, then 1/clamp(0,1e-6) creates 1e6; AdvantageGatedProposalFusion consumes it without validity masking. This can contaminate motion decisions whenever Search is invalid.
confidence: code defect verified; causal share high-confidence inference
